A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the card-type bar and the game-text box) with the corrected game text, and below it a white strip with the title and a black E, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 January 2013.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ESB2P-L-lonerogue-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Lone Rogue]]: The game text changes: “Shuffle, cut and replace.” is dropped; “any” becomes “your”. The slip adds a strip below the text box with the title “Lone Rogue” and an italic “E”.

The same area of the printed card (scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
